definitions.explanation: A unit of language that carries meaning.
A system of communication used by people.
The way something is said or expressed.

notes:
{言葉|ことば} is one of the most fundamental words in Japanese, covering meanings that English splits across "word," "language," and "speech/expression."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {言葉|ことば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧: to be understood, to communicate successfully
- {言葉|ことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to be at a loss for words
- {言葉|ことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose one's words carefully
- {言葉|ことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to speak to someone, to address
- {言葉|ことば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to fail to express oneself adequately
- {言葉|ことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{甘|あま}える→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧: to take someone at their word

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧: vocabulary word (individual unit, academic)
- ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧: word (suffix for language names: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧, ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧)
- ⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧: terminology, technical term

USAGE:
When meaning "language," {言葉|ことば} is less formal than ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧ (language as a system/academic concept). ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧ (dialect) is described as ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言葉|ことば} (the local language).
